# RETAW Solutions

> RETAW Solutions sells and installs RO (reverse osmosis) water purifiers for homes and businesses in the Maldives. Its main product, the S1 RO Water Purifier, costs MVR 5,660 with free installation and delivers clean drinking water from a dedicated faucet, so households don't need to buy bottled water.

## Key facts

- Business name: RETAW Solutions
- Location: Maldives (supplies and installs for customers across the country)
- Website: https://www.retaw.mv/
- Phone: +960 997 3829 and +960 400 4664
- Email: info@retaw.mv
- Social media: Facebook and Instagram @retawmv
- Main product: S1 RO Water Purifier (successor to the RETAW BR1)
- Price: MVR 5,660, installation free
- Filter change: MVR 600 every 6 months (MVR 1,200 a year); required for the S1 to clean water properly
- Warranty and support: 2-year warranty, 4-hour fault rectification
- Filtration: four-layer PCT Composite Filter Element (non-woven fabric, carbon fiber, high precision PP cotton, rear carbon rod), then a 400 GPD DOW RO membrane with filtration precision of 0.0001 micron
- Removes: sand, rust, chlorine, odour and fine particles (PCT element); heavy metals, bacteria, viruses, scale and organic matter (RO membrane)
- Capacity: up to 1,500 litres a day (about 1 litre per minute)
- Dimensions: 120 mm wide × 405 mm deep × 335 mm high
- Suitable for: households and businesses

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.retaw.mv/): overview of the S1, benefits, quick savings calculator and frequently asked questions
- [S1 RO Water Purifier](https://www.retaw.mv/product): full specifications, price, filter changes, warranty and service
- [How It Works](https://www.retaw.mv/how-it-works): the two-stage filtration process, layer by layer
- [Savings Calculator](https://www.retaw.mv/savings): compares bottled-water spending with the total cost of the S1 over 1, 2 and 5 years
- [Order / Contact](https://www.retaw.mv/contact): order form and direct contact details

## Savings estimate

RETAW Solutions estimates that one person drinks about 90 litres of water a month: 60 bottles of 1.5 L at about MVR 7 each, or MVR 420 a month. Net savings over N years = bottled-water spend − MVR 5,660 − (MVR 1,200 × N). Example: a 3-person household spending MVR 1,260 a month recovers the cost of the S1 in about 5 months and saves about MVR 63,940 over 5 years.
